about: The one model picker (owner 2026-11-08, 2026-11-24): the agent chats' picker and Work's (T3 Code's own) share these measures, in CSS pixels. Geometry is T3's (ModelPickerSidebar, ModelListRow, ComboboxSearchInput, ComposerModelEffort, ComposerControl as measured 2026-11-24); type, the capsule and the focus colour are the Atum Kit's. The desktop picker reads every value through model-picker-style.ts; scripts/build-work-theme.mjs gives Work the values T3 does not already have. Change a value here and both pickers follow.
